translate_en|mods/PropaneRefuel/42/media:
If enabled, welding torches can be filled directly at gas pumps.
Disable to keep welding fuel loot-only, so metalworking still depends on finding propane tanks.

If enabled, propane lantern bottles can be filled at gas pumps, making propane lanterns a renewable light source.
Disable to keep lantern fuel loot-only.

If enabled, propane tanker trucks added by other vehicle mods carry their own propane reserve you can fill from.
Has no effect unless such a mod is installed.

If enabled, a tanker parked at a working pump can be filled from it, making it a mobile propane store you can drive away and refill later.
Disable to make each tanker a one-time find that never refills.

How much fuel a gas pump uses to fill an empty welding torch.
Welding torches gate most metalworking, so this decides how much building a single pump is worth.

How much fuel a gas pump uses to fill an empty propane lantern bottle.
A full pump holds 100.

How much fuel a gas pump uses to fill an empty propane tank.
A full pump holds 100, so at the default of 20 each pump is worth five tanks. Raise it to make propane scarcer.

How much propane a tanker with no tank of its own can hold, and the most it can be found carrying. At the default 200 a full one is worth ten propane tanks.
Tankers with a real propane tank part use that tank's own capacity instead.

Least propane a tanker with no tank of its own can be found carrying. At 0 some are found empty.
Tankers that have a real propane tank part, such as Filibuster Rhymes' B42 tanker, use that tank instead and ignore this.

If enabled, pumps never run out of propane when the supply is separate. Pumps still need power.
With the supply shared, use the vanilla infinite fuel option instead.

Most propane a pump can start with, and all it can ever hold, when the supply is separate. At the default 100 a full pump fills five propane tanks.
Set both to 0 to start every pump empty.

Least propane a pump can start with when the supply is separate. Each pump gets its own amount between the minimum and maximum.
At the default refill cost of 20, every 20 is one full propane tank.

If enabled, propane can only be taken from a pump that has power -- from the grid, or from a generator when exterior generators are allowed. This matches how vanilla treats petrol.
Disable to let dead pumps still hand out propane.

If enabled, every gas pump has its own propane reserve, separate from its petrol, set by the options below. Taking propane never uses up petrol.
Disable to draw propane from the pump's petrol reserve instead, so the two compete.
